verdicts.description: One entry per finding id you were asked to adjudicate. Do not invent ids.

finding_id.description: Exactly one of the ids given to you.

verdict.description: CONFIRM: real as stated. REJECT: not a real defect. REVISE: real but mis-stated (wrong severity, wrong location, or wrong mechanism) - say the correction in reasoning.

severity.description: The severity you believe is correct. Use "none" with verdict REJECT.

reasoning.description: Why. If you are overturning your own earlier position, say so explicitly.

evidence.description: file:line references plus quoted code that you actually read this round. A verdict with no citation is not usable.

withdrawn.description: Ids of YOUR OWN earlier findings you now retract. Empty array if none.

notes.description: Anything the adjudication format could not carry. Do not raise new findings here; state them as a note only.
